about: The coach chat HTML of index.html (web 20261010-3), before md() and _coachBlocksHTML() were rebuilt on block models and _planChangeRows() returned raw text. Made by tests/golden/coach-html.js --write; lone surrogates written as <U+XXXX>. The homes group (12 cases): the Coach hub and connect HTML (renderCoach() on the hub view, one room: the markup has no room branch), frozen before renderCoach() was rebuilt on _coachHomeModel(), at web 20261012-2. Re-captured alone (--only): homes/hub-cut-emoji, the hub rebuilt on _coachHomeModel() cuts its preview in whole characters (contract 6.2), so the half emoji the 65-unit slice left is now the whole one.
